title: company-ops-rally-quarterly-orchestration-draft-v0-1
body:
Purpose:
- Single-source working doc for the next company-wide planning cycle: consolidate OKR drafts, executive talking points, and the all-hands run-of-show.
- Capture open questions, owners, and timelines so PMs/Eng/Go-to-market can iterate asynchronously.

Quick context / why now:
- After the product stability improvements last quarter we need a tight comms plan to shift narrative toward reliability + economics (cost/perf).
- Several Dedicated customers are entering renewals in Q2; want aligned exec asks for sales and CS.
- Leadership requested an abbreviated all-hands with focused outcome: clarity on top 3 company bets and where teams can contribute.

Top-level outcomes we want from this round of planning (success criteria):
1) Finalized company OKRs (Draft -> Exec review -> Published) by 2026-03-25.
2) All-hands that reinforces 3 bets, surfaces cross-team wins, and gives tactical commitments (30–40 minute event + 20 min team breakouts).
3) Exec update packet for sales/CS with renewal talking points and SLA improvements compiled and sent to field by 2026-03-28.

Proposed company OKR seeds (work-in-progress — please comment inline):
- Objective A: Make inference predictable and economical for production customers.
  - KR A1: 15% reduction in median serving cost per 1k tokens across top 10 hosted models (baseline Jan 2026).
  - KR A2: 99.95% availability for Dedicated clusters across 2 regions (measured monthly).
  - KR A3: Ship prefix/KV caching autopilot with per-route controls and telemetry (beta 50 customers).

- Objective B: Win enterprise trust and expand Private deployment revenue.
  - KR B1: Close 6 Private/On-prem deals (ARR >= $1.2M) with SOC2 + KMS commitments.
  - KR B2: Onboard 3 compliance integrations (Okta SCIM, Azure KMS, HSM) with reference docs.
  - KR B3: Customer NPS for enterprise segment >= 60 on Q2 survey.

- Objective C: Developer velocity and adoption — reduce friction to production.
  - KR C1: Developer time-to-first-call (sign-up to production request) under 30 minutes for 70% of new users.
  - KR C2: Launch two SDK language bindings and one example reference app for vector search.

Notes on KRs: these are intentionally measurable; owners: product-hosted-api for A, sales+solutions for B, devx for C. Need to sanity-check baselines with infra metrics (infra-metrics:dashboards).

All-hands draft run-of-show (target 50–60 minutes) — lean format:
- 00:00–00:03 Opening (Greet + 1-sentence theme) — CEO (prep: 2 slides)
- 00:03–00:12 State of the company (metrics highlight: latency, cost per token, revenue traction) — Head of Product
- 00:12–00:22 Big bets (3x 3-min segments; owners on stage) — Serving Runtime / Dedicated / Private
- 00:22–00:30 Customer highlight + CS ask (case short video + 2 tactical asks for product teams)
- 00:30–00:40 Live demo: Optimize suggestion flow + new rollout UI (30–60s per demo) — DevX
- 00:40–00:50 Town Q&A (curated + Slack-submitted) — CEO + panel
- 00:50–01:00 Breakouts / team commitments (small rooms; capture 1 commit each)

Logistics & format decisions to finalize:
- Keep event under 60 minutes — preference for pre-recorded customer clip to reduce live risk.
- Breakouts should be optional; capture commitments via a shared Google sheet.
- Ask managers to run 15 min pre-team huddles the day before.

Exec update packet (audience: Sales, CS, Partnerships) — sections to include:
- One-page headline: top 3 wins and 3 asks (renewals, SLA improvements, new case studies).
- Technical appendix: rollout plan for fallback policies and per-route cache control.
- Risk register: capacity shortfalls, 3rd-party infra dependencies, compliance deliverable dates.
- Suggested F&Q and reframing language for field during renewals.

Open issues / discussion items (needs decisions or owners):
- Q1: Baseline numbers for "serving cost per 1k tokens" — infra to validate (owner: Ethan Blake).
- Q2: Final definition of "availability" for Dedicated (SRE + Legal to align on SLA language).
- Q3: Which customers to feature in all-hands (CS to shortlist 3; sampling criteria: diversity of stack + willingness to appear).
- Q4: Do we run a live demo of Private deployment? Risk high — consider pre-recorded.

Immediate next steps (this doc = coordination hub):
- By 2026-03-12: Owners add baseline metrics and proposed measurement queries (infra, product analytics). (Owners: Ethan, Priya)
- By 2026-03-17: Exec review meeting (30 min) — finalize top-level OKR wording. (Owner: CEO/Exec EA)
- By 2026-03-20: All-hands comms draft + slide skeleton due for review. (Owner: Marketing + People Ops)
- By 2026-03-25: Publish OKRs + sync cascade with org leads. (Owner: Company Ops)

Communication plan / channels:
- Primary announcement: All-hands live + posted recording to #all with pinned resources.
- OKR doc: Confluence published and linked from People Ops; owners required to add team-level KRs within 1 week.
- Field pack: exec update packet to Sales/CS via SFDC and shared drive.

Prep checklist for contributors (quick TODOs):
- Slide owners: submit 3 slides max (one metric slide, one narrative slide, one ask slide).
- CS: draft 2-line customer summary and 1 suggested quote.
- DevX: prepare demo plan, fallback recorded video, and 1-pager on SDK changes.
- SRE: confirm Dedicated availability metric and incident retro summary slide.

Risks and mitigations (brainstorm):
- Risk: Late metric delivery -> Mitigation: accept stub numbers with clear caveat language in slides; include appendix for final numbers.
- Risk: Exec asks leak -> Mitigation: limited pre-reads only to exec + GTM leads; embargo until week-of.
- Risk: Customer no-shows for video -> Mitigation: backup customer + short anonymized case study.

Notes to reviewers (how to edit this doc):
- Use comments for high-level changes. In-body edits OK for tiny wording shifts, but major KR changes require a short justification comment and owner tag.
- If you add a KR, append owner and measurement method inline.

Small, messy working notes / scratch (typical drive-style):
- Need quick headcount asks slice? maybe 2 roles in SRE + 1 in DevX for Q2 runway.
- PR for rollout UI is blocking demo (github:repo/pull/271) — Samira to check merge date.
- Slack: #exec-prep for slide drop deadlines (use thread to confirm).
- TODO: create "one-pager for renewals" template; field to fill in customer-facing bullets.

If you are reading this and want to propose a change: add comment + tag owner. Otherwise assume owners above will iterate and we'll lock the doc before the exec review.

---
Versioning notes: this is intentionally rough; we expect multiple iterations. Please keep change notes in the comments section or paste diffs in the #company-rally slack thread.

End of doc.
